en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century industrial complex with multi‑storey brick mill buildings and two tall smokestacks. The factory is situated in a valley with a town of dense masonry houses and low hills in the background. Trees frame the foreground on the left and right, suggesting the view is taken from an elevated vantage point overlooking the factory district.
